balanced-equation-anatomy.alt: The equation N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g). Labels point to the coefficients 3 and 2 (how many particles or moles; change these to balance), to a subscript (never change it) and to a formula (it names the substance). Reactants are on the left and the product on the right. The atom count is 2 N and 6 H on each side, so mass is conserved.
